name: collapsible_column_scroll
description: CollapsibleColumn container combined with verticalScroll modifier

parameters.suspicious_reason: CollapsibleColumn decides which child to collapse by measuring against the viewport (CollapsibleColumnLayout.java:302-319), but ColumnLayout then positions the survivors against the virtual scroll dimension (ColumnLayout.java:316-325) and centres against it (ColumnLayout.java:412-414). That dimension is the pre-collapse 240px, so the two surviving 80px children are centred with a (240-160)/2 = 40px top offset: the collapse frees no space, it only moves the content down. The collapsed child is recorded at the end cursor (y=200). No children overlap.
